stem: Harsh eats only roti with ghee for several days. His list has no dal, fruit, vegetables, or drinking water. His younger sister needs different amounts of the same kinds of nutrients.

parts.text: Which claim about this diet is correct?

options.text: The diet is not balanced, because it misses essential nutrients, roughage, and water needed for growth.
The diet is balanced, because roti and ghee alone supply everything a body needs.
The diet is balanced for Harsh and must use the same amounts for his younger sister.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: A balanced diet needs all essential nutrients, roughage, and water in suitable amounts; roti with ghee alone leaves those out, and nutrient needs can differ with age.

teacher.key_rationale: Roti with ghee alone omits essential nutrients, roughage, and water, so the diet is not balanced. Needs can also vary with age, so the same amounts are not required for a younger sister.
